findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111 EJ present to monitor the control of roaches within the facility. See additional notes in General Comments. There were only a few glue traps present during today’s inspection Critical areas such as the floor behind equipment on the cook line were without glue traps. Three live adults and one live juveniles were observed under equipment on the cook line. All pests observed today were fast-moving. Ensure glue traps are out and dated at all times to monitor activity. SCDPH will continue to follow-up until no pests are observed. This means keeping the glue traps present as a monitoring tool and insuring treatment is curtailing life cycles. The next follow-up is scheduled for June 15, 2026. 

 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.
